items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I'd show up in there because Alphonse Pico was the one who started calling me Rat.

ctx.x: Yeah Yeah the band And they were there then? At the Palace Theater You see Pico play drum? Uh huh Pico the cab driver Yeah Pico was playing drum over there Oh yeah And uh Pico played drum at the Palace and uh uh uh Dave Oxley uh Dave Oxley Drummer player Dave Dave played there too Yeah Yeah
